build_moe_module: build a LinearGlm4MoeMoE module with a config to create a mixed expert layer with shared experts
create_experts_forward: create a forward pass through selected experts using hidden states, top-k indices, and top-k weights
route_tokens_to_experts: route tokens to experts by computing group scores and selecting top-k experts from router logits
review_forward_method: review the LinearGlm4MoeMoE forward method that combines routed expert output with shared expert residuals
refactor_expert_routing: refactor the route_tokens_to_experts method to support a different expert grouping or normalization strategy
